prefix_v6.description: NAT64 IPv6 prefix (must be /96); RFC 6052 compliant. Tayga uses this prefix to map IPv6 addresses to IPv4.

pool_v4.description: IPv4 pool used for dynamic address allocation during NAT64 translations. Should not overlap with existing network segments.

static_mappings.description: List of static IPv4-to-IPv6 address mappings (e.g., for servers that must have fixed IPv4 addresses in the NAT64 realm).

v6.description: Corresponding IPv6 address in the NAT64 prefix (e.g., 64:ff9b::c633:640a)

tuntap_dev.description: Path to the TUNTAP interface device. Tayga creates and manages this virtual interface for IPv6-to-IPv4 packet forwarding.

tuntap_addr.description: IPv4 address assigned to the TUNTAP interface. Must be within `pool_v4` subnet when using dynamic NAT64.

tuntap_mtu.description: MTU for the TUNTAP interface. Lower values (e.g., 1480) help avoid fragmentation with certain payloads.

dns64_enabled.description: Enable DNS64 functionality. Allows IPv6-only clients to resolve IPv4 hostnames via AAAA records synthesized by Tayga.

dns_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for upstream DNS queries issued by Tayga during DNS64 processing.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=error, 1=warn, 2=info, 3=debug. Set higher for troubleshooting.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file. Used by init systems (systemd, OpenRC) to manage the Tayga service.
